bead.title: Add ChangeRecord type, ChangeRecordSink port, and durable emission cursor
bead.description:
PROBLEM
pqueue emits no history: terminal items purge after retention and downstream systems (niflheim history projection, cayce delivery audit) have no ordered record of item lifecycle. TD-008 (docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-008-queue-history-change-records.md) specifies change-record emission as a committed-log tail consumer; this bead builds the engine-side foundation.

CURRENT STATE
- No emission seam exists in pqueue-engine (no sink/emit/cdc surface).
- The tail-consumer pattern to reuse: recovery replay reads LogStore::read_from (crates/pqueue-engine/src/compose.rs:1207); the group-commit facet shows the minimal runtime-free port style (compose.rs:158-205).
- QueueCommand variants to map are enumerated at crates/pqueue-engine/src/command.rs:49-60.

PROPOSED FIX
Per TD-008: add ChangeRecord (grain = per item x position; fields tenant_id, queue_id, item_id Option, position (epoch,seq), command_kind, new_state, item_version, terminal_at, emitted_at, source_owner_id, source_epoch; idempotency key = (tenant, queue, item, epoch, seq)); add trait ChangeRecordSink { fn emit(&self, shard, records) -> EngineResult<()> } as a runtime-free engine port; add a durable per-queue emission_cursor persisted like high_water, advanced only after successful emit (at-least-once). Implement CommandEnvelope -> Vec<ChangeRecord> mapping including queue-scoped records (SetGates/Pause/Resume with null item). Add emit_change_records: bool (serde default true) to QueueDefinition (crates/pqueue-core/src/domain.rs:629-632 region).

NON-SCOPE
- HTTP sink implementation and server wiring (sibling bead).
- Reap/emission-frontier coupling and metrics (sibling bead).
- Never touch commit_locked_batch (compose.rs:1346-1366) — emission is fully off the commit path.
bead.acceptance:
1. change_record_mapping: a batch push of N items at one position yields N records keyed (tenant,queue,item,epoch,seq); a queue-scoped SetGates yields one item-null record. cargo test -p pqueue-engine change_record_mapping
2. emission_cursor_at_least_once: simulated crash before cursor advance re-emits the same positions; a mock idempotent sink dedupes to the exact expected set. cargo test -p pqueue-engine emission_cursor_at_least_once
3. cargo test -p pqueue-engine and cargo test -p pqueue-core pass.
